why_nine_not_eight: Crew are assigned to multi-leg pairings, not to individual flights, so the count of affected rotations has no reason to equal the count of affected flights. 8 affected flights are carried by 7 rotations. PAIR-E1 spans 2 of them, which is why the rotation count is lower than the flight count. PAIR-A2 is additional via second_pairing. PAIR-B2 is additional via positioning. 7 + 2 = 9 rotations at risk. Every edge above names the mechanism that put that rotation at risk, so the total can be counted from the graph rather than taken on trust. Coordination and display only: duty-time legality is not validated anywhere in this system.
